page_title: OSA 0-2 ATM | Osasuna v Atletico Madrid 28/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
90+2' Atl. Madrid take a short corner kick.

90+2' Aitor Fernandez was forced into action to thwart Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper. The ball goes out for a corner. Atl. Madrid can continue in their attacking effort.
90+1' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Substitution. Aimar Oroz leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna).
90' Aitor Fernandez (Osasuna) was probably a bit loose with his words to Juan Martinez Munuera, who decides to show him a yellow.
87' David Garcia (Osasuna) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
87' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Osasuna.
85' It is too late to protest. Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) knew very well what he was doing and subsequently receives a second yellow card, ending the match for him.
85' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) is given a red card by referee Juan Martinez Munuera and leaves his team a man down.
84' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Juan Martinez Munuera didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
82' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid).

81' 0 - 2 Goal! A terrific long pass from Samuel Lino picks out an unmarked Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball low into the middle of the goal. 0:2.
80' Osasuna fail to score from a corner as Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid) leaps to collect the ball.
78' Substitution. Johan Mojica walks off the pitch and Kike Barja (Osasuna) comes on as a substitute.
78' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Ante Budimir is replaced by Raul (Osasuna).
78' Referee Juan Martinez Munuera has finally had enough of Jagoba Arrasate and gives him a straight RED CARD!
76' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
76' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Juan Martinez Munuera due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) and his team.
75' Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
75' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Now Osasuna have a corner.
74' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
73' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) will replace Marcos Llorente.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Iker Munoz (Osasuna) replaces Lucas Torro.
66' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to make a change. Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) replaces Pablo Ibanez.
66' The corner is swung in and Ante Budimir (Osasuna) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the right post from close in.
66' Osasuna force their opponents to concede a corner.

66' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom right corner. However, he couldn't beat Jan Oblak, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save. Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
64' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
62' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) sends a cross in and finds Ante Budimir inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
61' Substitution. Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) has come on for Nahuel Molina.
58' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
57' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar.
55' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
54' A yellow card for a tackle by Alejandro Catena (Osasuna). Juan Martinez Munuera doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
54' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
53' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Osasuna.
52' Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
52' Jan Oblak steps in and intercepts a long pass from Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).

51' One of the Osasuna players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Atl. Madrid, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
50' Jesus Areso plays a short pass through to Chimy Avila (Osasuna) inside the box, but he scuffs his effort well wide of the right post.
47' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
47' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. It's a throw-in for Osasuna.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Juan Martinez Munuera has a clear sight and sees a foul from Alejandro Catena (Osasuna). Atl. Madrid will take a free kick.
45+3' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
45+2' None of the Osasuna players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
45+1' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) and Aimar Oroz attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. It will be a corner kick for Osasuna.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
42' Referee Juan Martinez Munuera sees the trip by Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Osasuna have a free kick.

40' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Johan Mojica (Osasuna) is going to have a crack himself.

40' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle after Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Osasuna earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
38' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
37' What an excellent shot, but not the luckiest one. Johan Mojica (Osasuna) fires the ball from inside the penalty box but it only hits the left post!
36' David Garcia (Osasuna) sends a long ball in, but Jan Oblak comfortably gathers the ball.
33' Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
32' Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
31' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

28' David Garcia (Osasuna) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Juan Martinez Munuera stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Free kick. Atl. Madrid will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
28' The Atl. Madrid players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
24' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
23' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
20' 0 - 1 Goal! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 0:1.
18' Fine attempt! Lucas Torro (Osasuna) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
17' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

17' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) commits a rough challenge and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Jan Oblak, who pulls off a comfortable save!
13' Osasuna work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
12' Wow, what an escape. Ante Budimir (Osasuna) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The ball is out of play. Osasuna win a corner kick.
12' Dangerous play by Johan Mojica (Osasuna). Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
10' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
9' The foul by Ante Budimir (Osasuna) was seen by Juan Martinez Munuera who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Atl. Madrid are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
8' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) offside.
6' The ball rebounds to Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he bends the ball well wide of the left post.
6' It seemed like Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
5' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul. Atl. Madrid win a free kick.
3' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Osasuna will kick-off.
Juan Martinez Munuera got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
